correctness.rationale: The original self-review proves the r/r+1 final-color dichotomy, impossibility of forcing a blank in the split part, necessity of at most one blank nonsplit part, constructive sufficiency, the disjoint seed polynomial and the minimum coefficient. It reports exhaustive package checks of 34 profiles and 9,213,533 states. The finite checker is corroborative only.
